what: R125 learner assists and gentle catch-up, as data (br-2mxa). Assists are input-side: they edit the player's DRIVE/ACTION input before the normal vehicle path, never fight a deliberate full-lock input, and never add force that the engine, brakes and tyres don't. Catch-up scales the engine force of a car behind the leader. Every number is a starting value tunable in the owner tuning menu (br-2sdu); crates/jj-sim validates this file at load.
